def factor_log_volume_stability(df):
    """Stable volume persistence on log1p volume: negative CV of log1p volume over lookback."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    window = 20
    log_volume = np.log1p(df_copy['volume'])
    vol_mean = log_volume.rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean()
    vol_std = log_volume.rolling(window, min_periods=window).std(ddof=1)
    stability = -(vol_std / vol_mean.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    df_copy['factor_log_volume_stability'] = stability
    return df_copy['factor_log_volume_stability']
description: Parent captures smooth volume participation as negative coefficient of variation. This mutation applies log1p to volume before computing CV to reduce heavy-tailed skew and level sensitivity. The log1p transform compresses extreme volume spikes and yields a more symmetric distribution, preserving the stable participation mechanism while improving robustness in IC and RankIC. The core mechanism remains volume smoothness; the only change is normalization.
